signs.text: Dennis uses your first name when you come in, and it is the right one.
Dennis turns to you in front of everyone and asks what you think. Dennis listens to all of it.
Dennis moves a folder off the chair next to his. It might be for you. It might be that the folder was finished.
Dennis nods in your direction when you sit down. It could be a greeting. It could be the slide.
Dennis says that you will be copied in. Nobody says on what.
Dennis is cheerful with the whole room. You are in the room.
Dennis refers to you as "our colleague here". It may be that the name has slipped Dennis's mind.
You begin a sentence. Dennis finishes it, differently, and moves to the next slide.
Dennis asks you a question, then checks the answer with someone else while you are still giving it.
